subject: Culture
title: Forgiveness Rituals Reborn
description: A quick win: understand Forgiveness Rituals Reborn.

hook.text: South Africa's Truth and Reconciliation Commission aired apartheid crimes on live TV—and then forgave them.

buildup.text: Archbishop Desmond Tutu argued that justice without forgiveness traps nations in cycles of revenge.

discovery.text: Rwanda's gacaca courts processed genocide cases by requiring perpetrators to confess publicly before their victims.

twist.text: Forgiveness rituals don't erase pain. They create a shared story that lets both sides move forward.

climax.text: Neuroscience shows forgiveness reduces cortisol in the forgiver. Letting go is literally healing.

punchline.text: Forgiveness is a technology, not just a virtue.

quiz.question: Who led South Africa's Truth and Reconciliation Commission?
